# GetCitedGEO

GetCitedGEO is a specialized technical agency based in Melbourne, Australia, focused entirely on Generative Engine Optimisation (GEO). 

## What We Do
We help businesses uncover how their websites are performing on major AI platforms like ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, and Perplexity. Traditional SEO is no longer enough; AI is the new gatekeeper. If a business's website isn't structured to feed these AI models exactly what they're looking for, they become invisible to AI. 

We give businesses and explain a deep-dive technical AI Readiness Audit completely for free, showing them exactly how AI engines read, evaluate, and rank their brand versus their competitors.
